P1.1.text: Boston Omaha Corporation — Diversified Public Holding Company

P1.2.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband, Billboards, Bonds and Boston Omaha Asset Management.

P1.3.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband (telecommunications services), Billboards (outdoor advertising), Bonds (surety insurance) and Asset Management.

P2.2.text: Challenging the Way We Look at the Insurance Business

P2.3.text: General Indemnity Group (GIG) is an insurance holding company. The company specializes in acquiring and operating companies that underwrite and distribute insurance products.

P2.4.text: The innovative GIG team grows businesses by building digital, online offerings and modernizing outdated systems and workflows. They transform paper processes and methods of the past into more efficient digital and automated routines. Their expertise in data visualization, systems engineering, software design, product management, IT and HR is exceptional.

P2.5.text: Since its incorporation in, GIG has acquired five surety-only agencies, as well as an A- Excellent” (AM Best rating) monoline surety insurance company., United Casualty and Surety. United Casualty & Surety is licensed to write surety policies in all 50 states, and is approved by the United States Department of the Treasury (Dept. Circular 570) to bond federal projects throughout the United States.

P3.2.text: Boston Omaha Broadband (BOB) is a regional broadband provider specializing in fiber internet deployment within the markets served by our multiple operating subsidiaries.

P3.3.text: The BOB Internet Service Provider Companies

P3.4.text: Built on a Dream to Provide the Internet to the Underserved

P3.5.text: AireBeam is one of Arizona’s fastest growing fiber-to-home and fixed wireless internet service providers. The company successfully delivers affordable, accessible internet access and innovative solutions to rural communities across state.

P3.6.text: AireBeam was born from a need the company founders observed. Rural Arizona residents themselves, they noted a lack of access to reliable internet service in the area. In fact, most of the population couldn’t even handle small, day-to-day tasks via the internet.

P3.7.text: AireBeam is now a determined force for change in their local communities. They believe everyone should have access to fast, reliable internet service, especially the underserved.

P3.9.text: This alliance allows them to plan for additional Fiber-to-Home projects and expand services to not only consumers, but also to home builders, developers, build-to-rent communities, RV parks and others.

P3.10.text: Fiber-Fast Internet for New Homes and Build-to-Rent Communities

P3.11.text: Fiber Fast Homes, a Fiber-to-the-Home internet service company, delivers new home communities and build-to-rent communities with reliable, high-speed fiber internet services at Gig speeds.

P3.12.text: Today, new home buyers expect fast internet service that can handle the high-bandwidth demands of their smart homes, smart phones, home offices, communication and entertainment needs. Fiber Fast Homes manages that with their best-in-class technology and an elevated level of customer support.

P3.13.text: The company partners with builders, developers and build-to-rent communities to build fiber-to-the-home infrastructure and internet service, and provides concierge customer service to residents.

P3.15.text: Southern Utah’s First Internet Company and Still a Leader in Innovative Internet Service

P3.16.text: InfoWest specializes in providing reliable, cost-effective, high-speed home and business internet connections. the company has accrued the expertise and experience to connect their customers in remote locations with exceptional broadband service utilizing the latest in wireless technologies.

P3.17.text: InfoWest provides wireless broadband and fiber-optic internet services to residents and businesses throughout Utah, as well as select areas of Nevada, Arizona and Colorado. The company also delivers VoIP, TV, security and surveillance, IoT automation, personalized streaming services and a range of small business offerings.

P3.18.text: Consistently Ranked One of Utah’s Most-Trusted High-Speed Internet Providers

P3.19.text: Utah Broadband delivers broadband fiber and fixed wireless internet service to several counties throughout the front and back

data.primary_services: insurance brokerage; personal auto and home coverage placement; life insurance placement; commercial insurance placement

data.customer_segment: B2C: households buying personal auto, home, renters and life insurance; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses buying commercial insurance

data.end_markets: personal insurance; small business insurance; life and financial protection

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: carrier commissions paid when customers buy policies placed by its agencies; other: royalties and fees paid by franchisees that operate the agency locations

data.value_chain_position: service provider: places insurance coverage and advises customers, sold to households and businesses; distributor: sells insurance carriers' policies through its franchised agencies to consumers and businesses

data.geography_served: US national: nationwide across the United States through franchised agency locations

data.specialization: related lines: personal auto, home, life and commercial insurance lines sharing customers and agency channels

data.regulatory_exposure: high: state insurance producer licenses required to sell policies, regulated by state departments of insurance

data.offering_description: Operates a personal lines insurance distribution platform that sells home, auto, umbrella and other personal insurance policies from many carriers to individual consumers. Policies are sold through a corporate sales team and a network of franchise agencies. Earns commissions from carriers and royalties from franchisees.

data.end_markets: personal insurance; home and auto insurance; property and casualty insurance

P1.2.text: Smarter insurance, by design. Goosehead compares 150+ carriers for home insurance, auto, and bundled coverage at the best price. Get a quote in minutes.

P1.3.text: Goosehead is a full service property and casualty insurance agency. Coverages may not be available in all states or for all insurance companies. The description of coverage is for informational purposes only. Actual coverages will vary based on local laws, product availability, and the terms of the policy issued.

P1.4.text: Disclaimer: This information is not intended as an offer to sell, or the solicitation of an offer to buy, a franchise. It is for informational purposes only. We will not offer you a franchise unless we have complied with applicable pre-sale registration and disclosure documents in your state. Currently, the following states regulate the offer and sale of franchises: California, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin. Within the U.S.A., we offer franchises solely by means of our Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD). There are also countries outside the U.S.A. that have laws governing the offer and sale of franchises. If you are a resident of one of these states or countries, we will not offer you a franchise unless and until we have complied with pre-sale registration and disclosure requirements that apply in your jurisdiction.

P1.5.text: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Data

P1.6.text: Privacy Policy and Notice at Collection for California Residents

P1.7.text: You’re minutes away from the best coverage for your home, car and more.

P1.8.text: We shop 200+ carriers to find you the best coverage at the best price.

P1.9.text: Access your policy, file a claim, make a payment, or update your details.

P1.10.text: Submit replacement cost estimates, refinance requests, and more.

P1.12.text: Manage your policies, access documents, and get expert support, all in one state-of-the-art app.

P1.13.text: Our Digital Agent shops hundreds of insurance providers and builds a bundle customized for your insurance needs.

P1.14.text: With over 20 years of experience and over 1,000 successful franchises, we’ll set you up for success.

P2.2.text: Leading the way for our clients and our industry.

P2.3.text: real estate investor Robyn Jones and her husband Mark Jones, a senior partner at Bain & Co., founded Goosehead Insurance and began transforming the insurance industry by providing clients unprecedented information and product choice. Goosehead has since grown into a national leader by following one simple principle: putting the client at the center of our universe and building the business around them. We provide a wide array of options by shopping the market on our clients’ behalf, educating them, and helping them select the right protection with the right insurance carrier at the best value.

P3.2.text: Our offices across the country support our network of agents, partners, and clients, helping us deliver local expertise backed by national resources.
